declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesSylvester.actual_symmetric_matrix_with_positive_leading_minors_is_positive_definite

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesSylvester.actual_sylvester_criterion

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.finite_failure_union
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_failure_union {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (failure : ι → Set Ω)
    (budget : ι → ℝ) (hbound : ∀ i, μ.real (failure i) ≤ budget i) :
    μ.real (⋃ i, failure i) ≤ ∑ i, budget i

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.simultaneous_success
declarations.statement:
theorem simultaneous_success {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (failure : ι → Set Ω)
    (budget : ι → ℝ) (hmeas : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (failure i))
    (hbound : ∀ i, μ.real (failure i) ≤ budget i) :
    1-(∑ i, budget i) ≤ μ.real (⋂ i, (failure i)ᶜ)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.equal_fleet_failure
declarations.statement:
theorem equal_fleet_failure {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (failure : Fin 20 → Set Ω)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (failure i))
    (hbound : ∀ i, μ.real (failure i) ≤ 1/400) :
    19/20 ≤ μ.real (⋂ i, (failure i)ᶜ)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.independent_success_product
declarations.statement:
theorem independent_success_product {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (success : ι → Set Ω)
    (hindependent : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepSet success μ) :
    μ.real (⋂ i, success i)=∏ i, μ.real (success i)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.independent_success_lower
declarations.statement:
theorem independent_success_lower {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (N : ℕ) (success : Fin N → Set Ω)
    (hindependent : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepSet success μ)
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hbound : ∀ i, p ≤ μ.real (success i)) :
    p^N ≤ μ.real (⋂ i, success i)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.delayed_deterministic_discounted_violation
declarations.statement:
theorem delayed_deterministic_discounted_violation (gamma : ℝ) (hg : |gamma| < 1)
    (delay : ℕ) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, gamma^(n+delay))=gamma^delay/(1-gamma)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.positive_block_schur
declarations.statement:
theorem positive_block_schur {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (D : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : A.PosDef) [Invertible A] :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A B B.conjTranspose D).PosSemidef ↔
      (D-B.conjTranspose*A⁻¹*B).PosSemidef

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.positive_block_schur_lower
declarations.statement:
theorem positive_block_schur_lower {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (D : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hD : D.PosDef) [Invertible D] :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A B B.conjTranspose D).PosSemidef ↔
      (A-B*D⁻¹*B.conjTranspose).PosSemidef

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.tanh_derivative
declarations.statement:
theorem tanh_derivative (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt Real.tanh (1/(Real.cosh x)^2) x

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.tanh_derivative_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem tanh_derivative_bounds (x : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ 1/(Real.cosh x)^2 ∧ 1/(Real.cosh x)^2 ≤ 1

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.tanh_lipschitz
declarations.statement: theorem tanh_lipschitz : LipschitzWith 1 Real.tanh

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.tanh_monotone
declarations.statement: theorem tanh_monotone : Monotone Real.tanh

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.tanh_incremental_sector
declarations.statement:
theorem tanh_incremental_sector (x y : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ (Real.tanh x-Real.tanh y)*((x-y)-(Real.tanh x-Real.tanh y))

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.tanh_global_sector
declarations.statement:
theorem tanh_global_sector (x : ℝ) :

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.tanh_concave_nonnegative
declarations.statement: theorem tanh_concave_nonnegative : ConcaveOn ℝ (Ici 0) Real.tanh

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.tanh_chord_lower
declarations.statement:
theorem tanh_chord_lower (radius x : ℝ) (hr : 0 < radius) (hx : x ∈ Icc 0 radius) :
    (Real.tanh radius/radius)*x ≤ Real.tanh x

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.tanh_local_origin_sector
declarations.statement:
theorem tanh_local_origin_sector (radius x : ℝ) (hr : 0 < radius)
    (hx : |x| ≤ radius) :
    0 ≤ (Real.tanh x-(Real.tanh radius/radius)*x)*(x-Real.tanh x)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.neural_thermal_derivative
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.neural_thermal_lipschitz
declarations.statement: theorem neural_thermal_lipschitz : LipschitzWith (9/10) neuralThermalMap

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.neural_thermal_origin_contraction
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.neural_thermal_bias_disturbance
declarations.statement:
theorem neural_thermal_bias_disturbance (x bias disturbance : ℝ)
    (hb : |bias| ≤ 3/100) (hw : |disturbance| ≤ 1/50) :
    |(9/10)*x-(3/10)*Real.tanh (x+bias)+disturbance| ≤
      (9/10)*|x|+29/1000

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.biased_actuator_within_limit
declarations.statement:
theorem biased_actuator_within_limit (x bias : ℝ) (hx : |x| ≤ 1/2)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.tube_ultimate_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem tube_ultimate_bound (x : ℕ → ℝ) (q allowance epsilon : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon)
    (hstep : ∀ n, |x (n+1)| ≤ q*|x n|+allowance) :
    ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, |x n| < allowance/(1-q)+epsilon

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.biased_neural_recursive_containment
declarations.statement:
theorem biased_neural_recursive_containment (x bias disturbance : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hzero : |x 0| ≤ 1/2) (hb : ∀ n, |bias n| ≤ 3/100)
    (hw : ∀ n, |disturbance n| ≤ 1/50)
    (hstep : ∀ n, x (n+1)=(9/10)*x n-(3/10)*Real.tanh (x n+bias n)+disturbance n) :
    ∀ n, |x n| ≤ 1/2 ∧ |(-3/2)*Real.tanh (x n+bias n)| < 4/5

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.biased_neural_ultimate_radius
declarations.statement:
theorem biased_neural_ultimate_radius (x bias disturbance : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ n, |bias n| ≤ 3/100) (hw : ∀ n, |disturbance n| ≤ 1/50)
    (hstep : ∀ n, x (n+1)=(9/10)*x n-(3/10)*Real.tanh (x n+bias n)+disturbance n)
    (epsilon : ℝ) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :
    ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, |x n| < 29/100+epsilon

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.confidence_recommendation
declarations.statement:
theorem confidence_recommendation {α : Type*} (f lo hi : α → ℝ)
    (recommendation : α) (epsilon : ℝ)
    (hlower : ∀ x, lo x ≤ f x) (hupper : ∀ x, f x ≤ hi x)
    (hstop : ∀ x, hi x ≤ lo recommendation+epsilon) :
    ∀ x, f x-f recommendation ≤ epsilon

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.sampling_grid_margin
declarations.statement:
theorem sampling_grid_margin {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (f : X → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (grid : Set X) (coverRadius margin : ℝ)
    (hgrid : ∀ z ∈ grid, margin ≤ f z)
    (hcover : ∀ x, ∃ z ∈ grid, dist x z ≤ coverRadius)
    (hbudget : L*coverRadius ≤ margin) : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.multiple_constraint_witnesses
declarations.statement:
theorem multiple_constraint_witnesses {X ι : Type*}
    (f lower : ι → X → ℝ) (distance : X → X → ℝ) (L : ι → ℝ)
    (candidate : X)
    (hconfidence : ∀ i z, lower i z ≤ f i z)
    (hlip : ∀ i z, f i z-L i*distance candidate z ≤ f i candidate)
    (hwitness : ∀ i, ∃ z, 0 ≤ lower i z-L i*distance candidate z) :
    ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i candidate

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesValues.finite_discounted_doomed_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_discounted_doomed_bound (reward : ℕ → ℝ) (discount bound penalty : ℝ)
    (failure horizon : ℕ) (hd : 0 ≤ discount) (hd1 : discount < 1)
    (hb : 0 ≤ bound) (hp : 0 ≤ penalty) (ht : failure ≤ horizon)
    (hr : ∀ t < failure+1, reward t ≤ bound) :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.range (failure+1), discount^t*reward t)-penalty*discount^failure ≤
      bound*(1-discount^(horizon+1))/(1-discount)-penalty*discount^horizon

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesValues.supremum_doomed_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem supremum_doomed_bound {X : Type*} (returns : X → ℝ) (upper : ℝ)
    (hne : (Set.range returns).Nonempty) (h : ∀ x, returns x ≤ upper) :
    sSup (Set.range returns) ≤ upper

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesValues.negative_reward_extension_reverses
declarations.statement:
theorem negative_reward_extension_reverses :
    -(1:ℝ)-(9/10) > -(1:ℝ)-(9/10)-(9/10)^2

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesValues.two_step_slope_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem two_step_slope_bound (discount cost penalty : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ discount) (hd1 : discount ≤ 1) (hc : 0 ≤ cost) (hp : 0 ≤ penalty) :
    max (-cost-discount*penalty) (-cost-discount*cost-discount^2*penalty) ≤
      -penalty*discount^2

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesValues.slow_slope_strictly_better
declarations.statement:
theorem slow_slope_strictly_better (discount cost penalty : ℝ) (hd : 0 < discount) :
    -cost-discount*penalty < -cost-discount*cost-discount^2*penalty ↔
      cost < penalty*(1-discount)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesValues.negative_reward_slope_bound_false
declarations.statement:
theorem negative_reward_slope_bound_false (discount cost penalty : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < discount) (hc : 0 < cost) :
    -cost*(1+discount+discount^2)-penalty*discount^2 <
      -cost-discount*cost-discount^2*penalty

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesValues.every_binary_optimizer_safe_iff
declarations.statement:
theorem every_binary_optimizer_safe_iff (penalty : ℝ) :
    (∀ action, (∀ other, binaryValue penalty other ≤ binaryValue penalty action) →
      action=false) ↔ 1 < penalty

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesValues.equality_retains_unsafe_optimizer
declarations.statement:
theorem equality_retains_unsafe_optimizer :
    ∀ other, binaryValue 1 other ≤ binaryValue 1 true

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesValues.contraction_residual_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem contraction_residual_bound {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (operator : X → X) (fixed approximate : X) (discount residual : ℝ)
    (hd1 : discount < 1)
    (hcontract : ∀ x y, dist (operator x) (operator y) ≤ discount*dist x y)
    (hfixed : operator fixed=fixed) (hresidual : dist approximate (operator approximate) ≤ residual) :
    dist approximate fixed ≤ residual/(1-discount)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesValues.bellman_residual_example

remaining_research_theorem_families: Actual scalar-PSD RKHS construction/uniqueness, bounded evaluation, arbitrary-loss representer structure, ridge existence, scalar posterior asymptotic expansions, norm-convergent minimum-norm interpolation and sharp power-function errors are proved components. Remaining GP families include Gaussian conditioning/rank-one update, information gain and concentration theorems, exact source gradient formulas and spectral-norm remainder constants.

SafeOpt finite-time discovery/acquisition and kernel jump examples; GoSafe ODE existence/uniqueness to flow law, returnability and discovery. Lipschitz no-crossing and abstract flow suffix are proved components.

General infinite-horizon viability characterization, double-integrator continuous-time optimal braking and full penalized-policy optimality. The finite thermal graph and stopped-return upper bound are proved components.

General finite lifted LipSDP soundness, actual arbitrary-dimensional one-hidden-layer block LMI, spectral product gain, its exact feasible SDP point, genuine affine-parameter SDP convexity/local-global optimality, arbitrary-size logdet and actual block-weight derivatives, exact determinant Taylor remainder, inverse spectral boundary blow-up, Cholesky/Sylvester equivalences and validated norm-error margins are proved components. Remaining families include full recursive multi-layer selectors, exact optimized walkthrough value, further network exact Lipschitz constants, varying-mu training-path assumptions, and convolution realization.
Cayley general invertibility/orthogonality, SLL/AOL/Sandwich completeness, matrix convolution Gramian/weighted gain limits and REN contraction.

Numeric local tanh slope enclosures, complete local-sector LFT/LMI correspondence, printed delayed-system roots and general IQC results. Actual tanh local sectors and exact delayed-loop Lyapunov decay are proved components.

Full multi-layer CROWN correspondence, continuous-score conformal upper coverage and random-trajectory thermal event specialization, randomized-smoothing Neyman–Pearson theorem, Hoeffding and convex scenario probability theorem. General affine IBP and shared exchangeable-rank lower coverage are proved components.
